title: today, my AI powered RPG hit 3000 players so I made a trailer
author: W0RKABLE
selftext:
I build a browser based RPG, similar genre as for example Shakes & Fidget with the main mechanic being that you can generate your own items.

I've been working on this on, and off for about 2 years.

Would really appreciate feedback on my trailer. I'm comfortable in making games, but not quite in promoting them.

If you want to give the game a try, it's free to play at [https://azeron.ai](https://azeron.ai) :)

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: So is the AI basically just used for the forging?

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body: Forging is the core of the game, but there's more AI used live during the game, such as for evaluating how well your items fit together thematically, or for chatting with merchants.

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: Interesting, so is the 'thematic fit' something that's determining the strength of a build?

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body: In a campaign it's actually used for how well an NPC percieves you. But there will be future mechanic for gear upgrades where a thematic fit also comes into play.

comments.author: odd_noises
comments.body:
I applaud you building a full game, and I can tell you didn't just try to make some slop, but looking at this, the experience feels disjointed. I'm a little lost on what is the purpose of me putting in a description for what I want. How do I get resources to forge? Can I just put in a really powerful sounding prompt and get an OP weapon? What is the goal/end state for the game? What is the purpose of the character avatar if I can't seem the armor on it, and I can only see it in the inventory slot?

Long story short, this feels like it is technically sound but needs playtesting from people other than you. You could already be doing that, but im just talking from an uninformed outsider perspective

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body:
Those are very good questions, and exactly the feedback that I need.  
I think a lot of these are not clear from the trailer but would be answered during the gameplay.  
For example, as a forging resource you have Force Coins, which you collect from various activities.

If you ask for an OP item, you will usually get a bad result, the AI is taugh to recognize attempts to cheat the system by asking for overly powerful items. Instead, it values creativity, backstory, materials used and so on.

If you get a couple minutes, I'd like to see what you'll think after trying it.

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body: If you want to learn how to actually audit websites, use something like ahrefs or semrush, those are the most popular l. They will show you exactly what kind of traffic that website gets and what are the keywords it ranks for. You can even send us the report here. The website doesn't have big traffic but enough to get around 3 new users for my game per day :)

I customized a shadcn UI framework, but most of it is anyways built by hand with TailwindCSS since AI is pretty bad at design. There are some UI assets and images that are made either with Nano Banana or Midjourney.

comments.author: shoonee_balavolka
comments.body: Your game is a great reference for me, as I'm planning an Android game using a fine-tuned small LLM. Really cool stuff, and I hope it’s a huge success!

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body: Good luck and thanks! What kind of a model can you even reliably run on an average android device?

replies.author: shoonee_balavolka
replies.body:
I'm training Gemma3 1b.
It's compact, but it's difficult to run on anything but flagship Android devices.
Gemma3 has excellent multilingual learning capabilities, so it's great for supporting multiple languages.

comments.author: trikboomie
comments.body:
Sick, what is the combination logic? Do you let the llm infer from a predefined list of combination ?  
Does the AI run locally ?

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body:
There is nothing predefined, the stats for the item you create are solely based on your prompt.

How you combine your items afterwards does not use an LLM anymore, it just takes the stats from your items and your class, like any other RPG game.

The LLM is from an API :)
